kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-dns-service-rules --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-1y6h8z7imd2yu40000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDNSServiceRules

parameters.help_en: ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
Type of the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

Normal: normal type.

DNSRedirect: redirection type. This type redirects the current DNS service endpoint to another endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
DNS授权规则的目标类型。取值：

Normal：普通类型。

DNSRedirect：重定向类型，重定向类型指将当前DNS服务地址重定向至另一个地址
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en: IP addresses of destination DNS authorization rules
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en: Status of the DNS authorization rule
parameters.name: dns_service_rule_status

parameters.help_en: Names of DNS authorization rules. You can specify up to 20 rule names
parameters.help_zh: DNS授权规则名称。最多支持输入20个规则名称
parameters.name: dns_service_rule_name

parameters.help_en: IP addresses of source DNS authorization rules
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
Token for the next query. Valid values:

Omit this parameter for the first query or if no more results are available.

For subsequent queries, use the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
ID of the region where the cloud connector instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

DNSServiceRuleDescription.description_en:
Description of the DNS authorization rule.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and start with an English letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
DNSServiceRuleDescription.description_zh:
DNS授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`

DNSServiceRuleId.description_en: ID of the DNS authorization rule

DNSServiceRuleName.description_en:
Name of the DNS authorization rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and start with an English letter or Chinese character. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
DNSServiceRuleName.description_zh:
DNS授权规则名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

DNSServiceRuleStatus.description_en:
Status of the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

Creating: creating.

Created: created.

Deleting: deleting.

Updating: updating
DNSServiceRuleStatus.description_zh:
DNS授权规则的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。

Created：创建完成。

Deleting：删除中。

Updating：更新中

Destination.description_en:
Redirected DNS service endpoint.

This parameter is required when ServiceType is set to DNSRedirect
Destination.description_zh:
重定向后的DNS服务地址。

当ServiceType参数取值为DNSRedirect时，该参数必选

IoTCloudConnectorId.description_en: ID of the cloud connector instance

ServiceType.description_en:
Type of the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

Normal: normal type.

DNSRedirect: redirection type. This type redirects the current DNS service endpoint to another endpoint
ServiceType.description_zh:
DNS授权规则的目标类型。取值：

Normal：普通类型。

DNSRedirect：重定向类型，重定向类型指将当前DNS服务地址重定向至另一个地址

<props="china">

MaxResults.description_en: Maximum number of entries to return per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

Token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.

If NextToken has a value, it is the token for the next query
